title: ziziphus pedunculata
intro: Ziziphus pedunculata, commonly known as Spina Christi, is a plant species within the Rhamnaceae family, native to tropical Africa. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of Ziziphus pedunculata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
